about_the_game:
The Barnhouse Killer: A Deadly Game of Cards and Strategy

The Gameplay

  • Strategic Card Play: Predict how many hands you’ll win each round. Get it right, and the saw moves away. Get it wrong, and it inches closer.

  • Trump Suit Mechanics: Beat the leading suit or play a higher trump card to win the hand.

  • Dynamic Rounds: Play starts with 5 cards and cycles through 4, 3, 2, 1, then back up, changing your strategy every round.

  • Multiplayer Mayhem: Compete with up to 4 players online. Only the sharpest mind survives.

  • The Killer Stalks You: A relentless, tormenting presence keeps the tension high as you play.

The Experience

  • Tense Horror Atmosphere: Every move matters as the saw inches closer to its victims.

  • Fast-Paced Gameplay: Quick rounds keep you on edge and engaged.

  • Replayable Fun: Randomized trump suits and evolving strategies ensure no two games are the same.

  • High Stakes: Survival isn’t just about winning – it’s about outplaying everyone else.

content_descriptors.notes: This game features graphic violence, gore and psychological torment, including life-threatening scenarios. Viewer discretion is advised.

short_description: Trapped in a barn, strapped to a chair, and tormented by a sadistic killer, your survival hinges on one thing: a high-stakes multiplayer card game where every round brings you closer to life or death.
